_: GENERATED — what an authoring tool needs to FIND an operation. The calling table is the .lua beside it.

operations.name: Health check
operations.description: Returns the health status of the API. This endpoint is public and does not require authentication. Used for monitoring and uptime checks.

operations.name: List accounts
operations.description: Returns all accounts with current balances for the authenticated user, aggregating data from all connected providers (Plaid, GoCardless, Stripe, Mercury).

connectionId.description: Filter accounts by bank connection ID

operations.name: List bank connections
operations.description: Returns all bank connections for the authenticated user, including connections from all supported providers (Plaid, GoCardless, Stripe, Mercury).

operations.name: List holdings
operations.description: Returns investment holdings for a specific bank connection. Holdings include stocks, bonds, ETFs, and other securities. Currently only available for Plaid connections with the Investments product enabled.

bankConnectionId.description: The bank connection ID to fetch holdings from

accountIds.description: Comma-separated list of account IDs to filter holdings. If not provided, holdings from all accounts in the connection are returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of holdings per page (default: 100, max: 250)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (numeric offset) from the previous response's nextPage URL.

operations.name: List investment transactions
operations.description: Returns investment transactions (buys, sells, dividends, etc.) for a specific bank connection. Currently only available for Plaid connections with the Investments product enabled.

bankConnectionId.description: The bank connection ID to fetch investment transactions from

accountIds.description: Comma-separated list of account IDs to filter transactions. If not provided, transactions from all accounts in the connection are returned.

startDate.description: Start date for transactions in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 30 days ago.

endDate.description: End date for transactions in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions per page (default: 100, max: 250)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (numeric offset) from the previous response's nextPage URL.

operations.name: List transactions
operations.description: Returns transactions for a specific bank connection with filtering and pagination. Categories are returned using the v2 categorization system.

bankConnectionId.description: The bank connection ID to fetch transactions from

accountIds.description: Comma-separated list of account IDs to filter transactions. If not provided, transactions from all accounts in the connection are returned.

startDate.description: Filter transactions on or after this date (ISO 8601 format, e.g., 2024-01-01)

endDate.description: Filter transactions on or before this date (ISO 8601 format, e.g., 2024-03-31)

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions per page (default: 50, max: 250)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's nextPage URL. For Stripe connections, this is a transaction ID. For Plaid/Mercury/GoCardless, this is a numeric offset.
